∀ a b : R, a*b = b*a := by
  have h_sq : ∀ a : R, a * a = a := by
    intro a
    have := hR a
    rwa [sq] at this
  
  have h_add_sq : ∀ a b : R, (a + b) * (a + b) = a + a * b + b * a + b := by
    intro a b
    calc (a + b) * (a + b)
      _ = a * (a + b) + b * (a + b) := by rw [add_mul]
      _ = a * a + a * b + (b * a + b * b) := by rw [mul_add, mul_add]
      _ = a + a * b + (b * a + b) := by rw [h_sq a, h_sq b]
      _ = a + a * b + b * a + b := by abel
  
  have h_two : ∀ a : R, a + a = 0 := by
    intro a
    have h : (a + a) * (a + a) = a + a := h_sq (a + a)
    have h2 : (a + a) * (a + a) = a + a * a + a * a + a := h_add_sq a a
    rw [h_sq a] at h2
    have h_eq : (a + a) + (a + a) = (a + a) + 0 := by
      calc (a + a) + (a + a)
        _ = a + a + a + a := by abel
        _ = (a + a) * (a + a) := h2.symm
        _ = a + a := h
        _ = (a + a) + 0 := by rw [add_zero]
    exact add_left_cancel h_eq
  
  intro a b
  have h_ab_ba : a * b + b * a = 0 := by
    have h : (a + b) * (a + b) = a + b := h_sq (a + b)
    have h2 : (a + b) * (a + b) = a + a * b + b * a + b := h_add_sq a b
    have h_sum : (a + b) + (a * b + b * a) = (a + b) + 0 := by
      calc (a + b) + (a * b + b * a)
        _ = a + a * b + b * a + b := by abel
        _ = (a + b) * (a + b) := h2.symm
        _ = a + b := h
        _ = (a + b) + 0 := by rw [add_zero]
    exact add_left_cancel h_sum
  
  have h_ba_two : b * a + b * a = 0 := h_two (b * a)
  calc a * b
    _ = a * b + 0 := by rw [add_zero]
    _ = a * b + (b * a + b * a) := by rw [h_ba_two]
    _ = (a * b + b * a) + b * a := by abel
